title: Terraria's real prefixes: names and stats, rolled on drops, chest loot and shop buys; tooltip modifier lines
player_outcome: Items roll Terraria's real modifiers — Legendary, Godly, Unreal, Mythical, Menacing, Warding, … — with the real stats. Checking the prefix on new loot is back: chest, boss and enemy drops and shop purchases all come with prefixes. Tooltips show '+15% damage' style lines in green or red and the right sell price.
design: Verified: data/combat.json:22-41 has 18 partly invented prefixes. Prefixes.Fresh is only called by RecipeBook.Craft and the angler; LootRoller and TownCommerce.Buy create unprefixed stacks. ItemTooltip ignores the prefix.

New data/prefixes.json (manifest regenerated) with the Terraria 1.4.4 table, transcribed from the wiki Modifiers page and cross-checked. Groups: universal (Keen, Superior, Forceful, Broken, Damaged, Shoddy, Hurtful, Strong, Unpleasant, Weak, Ruthless, Godly, Demonic, Zealous).
Group common (Quick, Deadly, Agile, Nimble, Murderous, Slow, Sluggish, Lazy, Annoying, Nasty).
Group melee (Large, Massive, Dangerous, Savage, Sharp, Pointy, Tiny, Terrible, Small, Dull, Unhappy, Bulky, Shameful, Heavy, Light, Legendary).
Group ranged (Sighted, Rapid, Hasty, Intimidating, Deadly, Staunch, Awful, Lethargic, Awkward, Powerful, Frenzying, Unreal).
Group magic (Mystic, Adept, Masterful, Inept, Ignorant, Deranged, Intense, Taboo, Celestial, Furious, Manic, Mythical).

Group accessory (Hard, Guarding, Armored, Warding, Precise, Lucky, Jagged, Spiked, Angry, Menacing, Brisk, Fleeting, Hasty, Quick, Wild, Rash, Intrepid, Violent, Arcane). Duplicate names get suffixed ids (quick_accessory, deadly_ranged, hasty_accessory) with the shared display name.

PrefixDef gains MeleeSpeed; Prefixes.AccessoryStats adds MeleeSpeed. Remove the prefixes block from data/combat.json. aliases.json maps old ids: stout→unpleasant, brisk→quick, towering→massive, stubby→tiny, mythic→legendary, farsighted→sighted, unerring→unreal, transcendent→mythical, frugal→adept, sturdy→guarding, fleet→fleeting, swift_tool→quick.

Prefixes.Groups per Terraria: swung melee and tools → universal+common+melee; non-swung melee (spear, yoyo, flail, boomerang/throw) → universal+common only; ranged → universal+common+ranged; magic and summon → universal+common+magic; accessories → accessory. Uniform pick among eligible.
Prefixes.Value: Terraria's multiplier (damage × (2 − useTime) × (2 − mana) × size × knockback × velocity × (1 + crit·0.02), accessory steps), squared.

Add Prefixes.Apply(ref ItemStack, content, ref rng) and call it in LootRoller.Emit for Count == 1 prefixable items (covers enemy, boss, crate and chest loot, including EnsureContainerLoot) and in TownCommerce.Buy. PlayerSave.Fill drops prefixes that don't apply to the item's groups.

ItemTooltip: stats via Prefixes.Damage/Crit/Knockback/UseTime; new TooltipKind.Modifier lines ('+15% damage', '-10% speed'; positive/negative flag for P2 colouring); sell price = Prefixes.Value(stack)/5 × count; Generic damage prints 'N damage'.
data_changes: data/prefixes.json (~83 prefixes, exact Terraria stats; weights 1)
tests: PrefixTests: 'legendary' has +15% damage, +10% speed, +5 crit, +10% size, +15% knockback; a spear can never roll a size prefix
PrefixTests: LootRoller with a seeded rng gives an enchanted_sword drop a prefix in ≥ 60% of 100 rolls; TownCommerce.Buy of copper_pickaxe can carry a prefix
PrefixTests: a saved stack with old 'mythic' loads as Legendary; an accessory prefix on a weapon is dropped on load
PrefixTests: the tooltip of a Legendary copper broadsword contains '+15% damage'
verification: In-game: reforge at the Goblin Tinkerer shows Terraria names
risks: Transcription errors in the prefix table; add a table test for a few known values per group.
ItemTooltip is also changed by P2 (layout/colours); P3 owns the data lines, P2 the rendering.
TownCommerce is also touched by P4 (shops); keep this edit small.
